findings.title: Keep the selected ACP ID in the save request
findings.body: Must-fix: `Dialog::save` records `terminal` only from `native`, so saving an ACP session drops its ID even though `project-save-preview` was requested for that exact ACP session. If the same project has a native main terminal whose captured cwd resolves to a different workspace (for example, the shell has changed into another repository), submission falls back to that native terminal in `Daemon::project_save_source` and fails `expected_context` despite the selected ACP directory being unchanged. Preserve `source` for both session kinds so preview and save resolve the same target.

findings.title: Encode all configurable function keys before forwarding them
findings.body: Should-fix: `mode_key` accepts F1 through F24, but both the double-press path here and the explicit Send reserved mode key action call `key_bytes`, whose function-key encoder returns an empty vector for F21–F24. Configuring any of those advertised values therefore reserves the key from the application while making both documented escape hatches silently deliver no key. Extend the native encoder for the supported range, or restrict the advertised/configurable range consistently.

findings.title: Bound automatic launch names to the accepted request budget
findings.body: Should-fix: A configured profile label may legally contain 128 UTF-8 bytes (`acp_profiles::validate_profiles`), but `default_name` unconditionally appends a space and eight-byte suffix and sends that value as an explicit `name`. `Daemon::acp_open` rejects explicit names over 128 bytes, so an available profile with a 120–128-byte label cannot be launched from the otherwise untouched basic form; the dialog is already dismissed when the asynchronous rejection arrives. Generate a UTF-8-safe bounded automatic name that retains its suffix and satisfies the backend limit.
